name: A known piece's title in quotes
when: the library holds a piece and the question is where else it lives: mirrors, reprints, translations, reviews, responses
shape: "<exact title>" — optionally with the person's surname; no site:
yields: reprints on other hosts, the PDF on an institute's site, reviews and replies that quote the title
misses: a title changed in reprint or translation; a title too generic to be a phrase
origin: the Stacks' works.resolve and the Referee's fetch pool both search titles verbatim (design note §3)
